environment.description: Django REST API deployed on a shared EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, with multiple application containers sharing the same /tmp filesystem via host mount. The application runs as ec2-user with default umask 0022. Other tenant containers on the same host can read /tmp. The origin server is directly accessible on port 8000 via the instance's public IP (security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8000). No CloudFront distribution is configured; the ALB routes directly to the origin.

config.tmp_mount: shared host /tmp bind-mounted into all containers
config.network: ALB -> EC2:8000, security group allows direct origin access on 8000
config.container_isolation: none - shared PID and mount namespace for /tmp
